# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them through GitHub's private [Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/llm-fallback-compatibility-tester/security/advisories/new) feature. Include a description of the issue, reproduction steps, and potential impact. If private reporting is unavailable for this repository, use GitHub's reporting controls on the project owner's [profile](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib).

The maintainers will acknowledge reports and share a resolution timeline after reviewing the issue. Do not include secrets or personal data that are not needed to reproduce the vulnerability.
